title: Compliance Evidence Collector
description: Collects dated audit evidence from what the tasks and the repository already hold (spec approvals, QA reviews, tests, security checks, merges, releases, policies, incidents) and judges each control of a framework with it. No model is called.
noData: Pick a framework and a month, then run the collection to see which controls have recent evidence.

errors.noProject: Select a project to collect its compliance evidence.
errors.frameworkFiles: Some framework files of the project were skipped:

monthly.label: Monthly report for this framework
monthly.hint: On the 1st of each month (or at the first start after it), the report of the month just ended is saved in .workpilot/compliance/reports/, and a control without evidence for over 30 days is announced on your notification channels.

summary.line: {{covered}} of {{controls}} controls covered ({{percent}} %), {{gaps}} gap(s), {{alerts}} without evidence for over 30 days.

summary.noRisk: No control is missing or failing.
